{"reason": "Replace the demand-forecast-error branch condition: lower the bias threshold from 0.1 to 0.02 and add market-signal-mismatch? as an alternative. The 14 costly rows are all v1='unknown' with truth='demand-forecast-error' — six have market-mismatch=#t with forecast-bias=#f, others have bias 0.065–0.081 under the 0.1 gate. This should cut unknown=23 and lift accuracy/recovery while leaving supplier-delay intact.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.02))
         (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
